_about: Everything a reviewer could notice in sample_diff.txt. The offline scripted reviewer 'notices' all of these; the prompt decides which it reports. 'label' is the ground truth from a senior-reviewer audit; 'rubric_severity' is what the explicit severity rubric prescribes; 'unguided_severity' is what a reviewer picks with no rubric; 'self_confidence' is how sure the reviewer feels.

observations.issue: SQL is built with an f-string from the customer argument; customer="x' OR '1'='1" returns every customer's orders. Use a parameterized query.
observations.label: true_positive

observations.issue: Floor division drops the last partial page: 120 rows -> 2 pages, so rows 101-120 are never shown. Use ceiling division.
observations.label: true_positive

observations.evidence: # Returns None when the order does not exist.
observations.issue: Comment says None is returned for a missing order, but orders[order_id] raises KeyError; callers that check for None will crash.
observations.label: true_positive

observations.evidence: # Look up all orders for a customer.
observations.issue: Comment says 'all orders' but only the id and total columns are selected; consider 'Look up order ids and totals'.
observations.label: false_positive

observations.evidence: # Formats an order as a CSV line.
observations.issue: Comment does not mention that fields are not quoted or escaped.
observations.label: false_positive

observations.issue: summarize() has no type hints or docstring.
observations.label: false_positive

observations.issue: PAGE_SIZE is hard-coded; move it to configuration. (Every other export module in this repo defines its page size the same way.)
observations.label: false_positive
